system.description:
7th Level Clan Feature

The Namikaze clan has a unique talent for manifesting Swift Release due to their close affinity to both Wind and Lightning Release. You gain the second Nature release you didn’t select from Swift Release Affinity clan trait and when casting a jutsu with either Lightning or Wind Release keywords, you can change the damage type to Wind or Lightning respectively.

Additionally, once per turn, at the beginning or end of that turn, you can spend 1 Speed Seal to teleport to a creature or object marked with your Speed Seal, so long as they are within 120 feet of you.
